title: Temporary duty at the Pentagon handling Vietnam War protesters

tellings.quote: dur during the Vietnam War I was I was brought TDY temporary duty to the Pentagon because demonstrators were throwing balloons full of blood

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a former US Army man later known for remote viewing, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that during the Vietnam War, in the late 1960s, he was sent on temporary duty, what the military calls TDY, to the Pentagon, the headquarters of the US military in Washington, DC. He says this was because protesters against the war were throwing balloons full of blood. He tells it as part of his own story of how he came to serve close to the centre of military power.
